about: Incorporated in 2022, Bajel Projects Ltd is in the business of Engineering, Procurement and Construction [1] Bajel Projects Limited (BPL) is a carved out legal entity from Bajaj Electricals Ltd. It's EPC segment comprises of Power Transmission & Power Distribution. BPL provides end to end solutions ranging from inhouse design, testing, procurement, manufacturing, installation & commissioning of the projects.
